title: incident-bot: on-call guided diagnostics and runbook suggestions
author: Maya Patel
commits: feat: initial guided diagnostics flow and runbook matcher
test: add integration tests for on-call suggestions
chore: update ci to run new integration suite
fix: handle nil runbook entries in matcher
description: Add an on-call guided diagnostics flow to incident-bot that surfaces relevant runbooks, recommended checks, and quick remediation steps when SLO/alert context is available. Motivation: during recent incidents multiple on-call engineers missed high-value runbook links; this PR injects a lightweight matcher that scores runbooks by signal-context overlap and exposes a compact preview in the on-call UI and Slack/PagerDuty messages. Key changes: 1) new diagnostics package with the GuidedDiagnostics API, 2) runbook matcher that uses tag and SLO correlation heuristics, 3) UI preview component and modal with copyable commands, 4) integration tests and fixtures, 5) telemetry for suggestion impressions and follow-through. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (SRE-214) [x] unit tests for matcher [x] integration tests for UI + API [x] e2e smoke run in staging. Backwards compatibility: existing runbook storage and links untouched; matcher is opt-in via incident-bot config flag (enabled=false by default). Rollout plan: enable for 10% of incidents in staging for 48h, monitor impressions and false-positive rate, then ramp. Implementation notes: matcher uses a small TF-IDF-ish scoring over runbook tags and SLO labels to avoid heavy ML infra; future iterations may add embeddings. This description consolidates context, implementation, testing, telemetry, and rollout guidance for reviewers and SRE owners.
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice end-to-end. Can we avoid evaluating the full runbook corpus on every alert? Suggest caching top candidates per alert fingerprint.
Maya Patel: Added a short-lived candidate cache keyed by alert id and fingerprint, TTL 10m. See pkg/diagnostics/cache.go commit.
Priya Sharma: Please add metrics for suggestion precision and a counter for ignored suggestions so we can tune thresholds.
Maya Patel: Added metrics: diagnostics.suggestions.total, diagnostics.suggestions.ignored, diagnostics.suggestions.actuated. Also added a Grafana dashboard link to docs.
Jordan Kim: UX looks good, but the Slack message payload may exceed limits for very long runbooks. Can we trim the preview and link to a modal?
release_notes: Add on-call guided diagnostics that surface runbook suggestions and quick remediation steps; opt-in via incident-bot configuration; adds telemetry and integration tests.
